question: BQVH is related to HLZE in a certain way. In the same way, HSJQ is related to NNNN. To which of the following is JOWF related, following the same logic?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/029c2b23a9e06140bf29a6e9bf1186a53a5e6b780d1d70e764a623fcf7b12d9a.png] Logic followed here is: Each letter in the first group of letters is shifted by a specific sequence of positions (+6, -5, +4, -3) to determine the corresponding letter in the second group. **BQVH is related to HLZE →**
